name: mscse-4plus1-senior-no-admission-term
description: Policy review round 3, P3-fourplusone-3 (DGS 2026-10-07: apply the suggested handling). A 4+1 senior (bachelor's in Spring 2027, the current semester) has not said when they were admitted to the Integrated B.S. + M.S. program. CSE 60641, taken in Fall 2026 as an undergraduate and not shared with the bachelor's, reads "not counted yet" (2026-10-04) — and the Graduate School's UG→GR move, which cannot be made after conferral, used to go unmentioned. The warning now says it as a condition.
expectWarnings: If you were admitted to the Integrated B.S. + M.S. program by the semester you took CSE 60641, it must be moved from undergraduate (UG) to graduate (GR) registration before your bachelor’s degree is conferred (Spring 2027)
expectNoWarnings: the graduate courses you are counting beyond the shared pair must be moved
